title: eustachys paspaloides
intro: Eustachys paspaloides, commonly known as 'Saltbrush', is a flowering plant species in the grass family. It is native to tropical Africa and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Eustachys paspaloides include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Eustachys paspaloides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
